mapper.select: SELECT tc.organization_id AS organization_id, tc.id AS teaching_class_id, tc.name AS class_name, tc.code AS class_code, tc.status AS class_status, b.id AS binding_id, b.course_space_id AS course_space_id, c.title AS course_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edu_class_student cs WHERE cs.teaching_class_id = tc.id AND cs.joined_at <= #{at} AND (cs.left_at IS NULL OR cs.left_at > #{at})) AS student_count FROM edu_teaching_class tc LEFT JOIN edu_course_class_binding b ON b.teaching_class_id = tc.id AND b.published_at <= #{at} AND (b.ended_at IS NULL OR b.ended_at > #{at}) LEFT JOIN edu_course_space c ON c.id = b.course_space_id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE tc.status = 'ACTIVE' AND tc.organization_id IN ORDER BY tc.organization_id, tc.id, b.id
